title: ArXiv limits preprint submissions to two per month per submitter, as AI access fuels a record 40,363 submissions in September 2026, vs. 20,569 in September 2024 (Kat Boboris/arXiv)
summary: Kat Boboris / arXiv: ArXiv limits preprint submissions to two per month per submitter, as AI access fuels a record 40,363 submissions in September 2026, vs. 20,569 in September 2024 — arXiv, and the scientific community at large, are facing a watershed moment. Scholarly publishing is currently changing at a rapid pace …
